value.title: Sudama!! Cromartie Girls High School / Fancy Club / Welcome to the Jungle / Tales of the Four Lords of Cromartie
value.synopsis: It’s Cromartie Girls High School and everyone is a princess! It’s Ms. Kamiyama’s first day and “she” walks around the school meeting all the princesses. Back at Cromartie High, Kamiyama, Hayashida, and Maeda talk about their future and how normal everything is.
